stops.title: Setting up
stops.caption: Regions, then branches.
stops.speech: Setting up starts with regions, then the branches inside them, because every member and every group belongs to a branch.

stops.title: Your first branch
stops.caption: Name it, place it, lead it.
stops.speech: Give the branch a name, a city and a service schedule, then assign its pastor. Members can be added or imported after that.
